architecture_scope: One shared fabric with all 20 compute cores. Persistent attention context disabled.
scope: Compiled memory on the elaborated source candidate. Inferred register arrays and an unmapped or unplaced chip are outside this inventory.
paper_sign_bank_observation: Figure 31.6.2 places a surviving-sign bank in each aggregator. Figure 31.6.3 sizes its depth to image width and its word to the sign-vector width. Neither labels a fixed 3 KB capacity.
candidate_sign_bank_observation: The shared layer uses one 24-entry by 2048-bit source sign array in the cumulative token merger. The 602-entry native compiled-memory ledger excludes that array.
rationale: The five core/aggregator groups match the labeled capacity subtotal when interpreted in binary units. The current shared design has separate feed-forward prediction metadata banks. The paper does not resolve the fixed byte allocation of the surviving-sign banks or the unit convention.
